reviews.text: My dog loves Furry Tails! He’s always excited to go and comes home tired. The owner is very flexible and the prices are reasonable.

This place comes through for us every single time! The staff is always friendly, accommodating, and takes great care of our dog.

One thing we really appreciate is that if your dog has an appointment, they’ll let you drop them off in the morning and pick them up at closing without charging an extra daycare fee. Most places charge for that, so it’s a huge plus.

Their prices are very reasonable, and they’ve dyed my dog multiple times—they always do an amazing job! We couldn’t be happier with their service and highly recommend them.
Wonderful place!  They take such good care of my dog for boarding and grooming services.  Highly recommend!  And prices are great!
They deserve all the stars!! My dogs always come out looking their best and they’re so good with them!
They never asked for reviews. I am so glad I found this place.

Today I took my kitten Felix to Furry Tails. They bathed him and gave him a beautiful haircut. Excellent work! 5 stars! They knew how to work with my pet, even though he's a bit aggressive. He received great treatment. I highly recommend Furry Tails.

I love the haircut they gave my maincoon. I didn’t want a lion cut but just wanted something short enough to help with summer shedding.  They did so good ! He looks so cute ! Before and after! Thank you furry tails for making my kitty look so handsome

I give 5 star for my pup grooming . It’s my first time giving my pup here , the groomers are friendly and did the hair cut how I exactly described. The price is reasonable of 75$ including everything.
I would recommend this place to pet parents and I’ll be coming here for my pup grooming. Thanks a lot for the front desk guy . The store is beautiful decorated.

Excellent service today! Took Daisy and Duke here for nail grinding and gland expression. I had their nails done at Petsmart the last time and was not very pleased with their service. They barely cut their nails and their nails pretty much looked the same. I  expressed to the tech how displeased I was with their service. She was very kind and did such a great job on Duke’s nails (which are black). The gentleman did a great job as well. Thank you for making me a happy customer! Highly recommend this pet groomer for your fur babies! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Furry Tails is amazing! We have struggled to find a groomer that we like and we finally found it! We made an appointment over the phone and it was extremely smooth and seamless. When we went to drop our puppy off they asked wonderful questions to ensure they did exactly what we wanted. We are we’re appreciative of that. I cannot recommend this place enough! Our Coco looked so cute and the cut was pristine! Normally, our Coco is super anxious when it comes to groomer, but at pick up she was so good! You won’t regret using Furry Tails!
Reliable service in a convenient location.
Friendly and fast service! Been coming here for years and worth the trip out here.

Was lucky to find this place last year.The other places I was taking my dog for grooming were not able give her provide the special attention she required.She's 15 yrs.,hard of hearing and has vision problems.They took her in and I almost cried after her first grooming.There were no issues and her hair cut was perfect.I've been going there since.

My dog ​​loves to go to this place!   The staff is very friendly and they took care very well of my dog ​​for two weeks.   The place is always clean and did a good job by cutting and styling my yorkie . She has long hair.  Totally recommend this place 🙏🏻.
If you’re looking for the best doodle cut groomer please ask for Daisy! Been going to her for 4+ years and this is the result every time! Truly the best!!!

10/10! This was my 2nd time taking my pets to Furry Tails. The 1st time I took all 3 of my pups and they all smelled and looked great! Today I took my oldest, Ellie, who needed an immediate furmination and bath. She is usually the most anxious out of the 3 but with this being her 2nd time, she went to the back like nothing! She was done within 2 hours and is as happy as can be! Staff is super friendly and check out is super easy. Will be using Furry Tails moving forward!!

Took my adult cat to get bathed. The packet deal was $40, includes bathing, nail trimming and ear cleaning.Had to go back after 10mins to pick her up because they told me they couldn’t bath her because she didn’t want too and was charged half the price, they ended up cutting her nails and placing a no rinse shampoo?. I didn’t agree to it because I could of done those simple things myself and got charged half the price when I mostly went there to get her bathed. Wished they asked or called before doing those things, could of found another place. Also their website said they know how to handle grumpy cats???
They are the best. I've been coming here for my Cookie since I first got her. Grooming and boarding are always top notch!
I love this place and my 🐶🐶🐶🐶 always look amazing ♥️ …
They did an excellent job cleaning up my babies.
My dogs love this place. They offer really good services. The prices are affordable and I highly recommend this place.

We’ve been coming here for years and used to love it but it’s just seemed to get progressively worse with each visit. The grooming itself was no longer consistent and choppy . Unfortunately we will no longer be returning after our girl came back bleeding. They let us know that this is normal but the fact that it’s on multiple nails just feels a little negligent in my opinion. Really wish them the best but will be taking my business elsewhere.
They do grooming and boarding. Great place!

Took two dogs there for 3 days of boarding, The staff was very nice and friendly. I had one dog groomed, and it went well. The price was cheaper than anywhere else, I would recommend this place and would return.

Loved it! I’m pretty picky about Milo’s grooming, but this place exceeded all my expectations! He’s a big boy (98 lb chocolate labradoodle) but the staff was super friendly and made sure Milo was comfortable the whole time. They really paid attention to detail and did an amazing job! Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great grooming. Thank you Daisy! Five stars!

Just average. Grooming is a high expense and in my opinion should always be great. I had to ask for my dog to get shaved down more once I arrived. I got the deshedding treatment however I can still easy pull hair off my dog.

Does a per groomer not know you should not cut cats whiskers?????
This was the second time I took my cat there. First time, I specifically asked for them to trim her hair short under her belly and clip her nails. None of those were done. I took her again few weeks ago and ask them for a lion cut. I asked them to cut her hair the longest they possibly could and they said they will cut whatever the cat allows… which was fine. When I got the cat back, I noticed they have cut my cat’s whiskers short!! I was very upset. I called them and asked them why they did that, and they told me to let them know next time not to cut the cat’s whiskers… but who cuts cats whiskers short??? Will not go back ever again… my cat has been acting strange since I got her back.

These guys are getting out of hands on the no if times they do the things wrong. The last time i went to them the grommer made a blunder with the clipper and cut through the hair and made a deep trim at the leg which was soo visible and odd …

I absolutely hate leaving bad reviews but I just couldn’t stay silent. After doing my research on places to get my dog groomed I decided to give this establishment a chance since overall they had positive reviews so I don’t understand what …

My pup always comes back looking her best.  Great cut, nail grind, and cute bandana.
